title: Authority hardening successor: local fail-closed repairs and external-root boundary

nodes.objective: Make a bare DeliveryGrantLedger incapable of recording or spending a delivery grant; require a matching sealed owner-authority anchor.
nodes.stopping_condition: A bare ledger refuses record and require_issued, matching owner provenance succeeds, and the required test is green on the exact candidate.
nodes.rollback: Revert only the successor candidate commit; retain audit evidence and the external-root residual.
nodes.lesson: Fixture-only anchoring is not deployment; fail closed before the anchor exists.

nodes.objective: Require a live AuthorityRegistry for every effect gateway and durable outbox operation so expiry and revocation are always observed.
nodes.stopping_condition: A registry-less gateway refuses a genuinely issued token and bound durable execution remains green.
nodes.rollback: Revert only the successor candidate commit; retain the revocation-bypass finding.
nodes.lesson: A token is only live while its issuing registry can check it.

nodes.objective: Fail closed at the retired RepositoryMission direct GitHub delivery seam until a separately reviewed authority-bound controlled-delivery migration exists.
nodes.stopping_condition: The legacy target produces a failed mission report before any transport call, while controlled delivery tests remain green.
nodes.rollback: Revert only the successor candidate commit; do not re-enable direct delivery without a migration ADR.
nodes.lesson: A compatibility seam that bypasses authority is an authority bypass.

nodes.objective: Independently establish that custody, rotation, revocation, and rollback records needed by an external root have a current durable storage and recovery basis.
nodes.stopping_condition: A Steward records an exact-candidate durability and recovery verdict for the root-integration evidence path; a historic receipt alone is insufficient.
nodes.rollback: No production state changes; preserve the durability audit and defer integration if recovery is incomplete.
nodes.lesson: External authority claims need durable custody and recovery evidence, not only in-process correctness.

nodes.objective: Disable caller-controlled autonomous runtime pushes, draft-PR creation, comments, and authenticated comment polling until an authority-bound controlled-delivery migration exists.
nodes.stopping_condition: Caller-controlled remote flags and every autonomous remote gateway or feedback entry point refuse before a Git or HTTP operation, while local-only PIT supervision remains green.
nodes.rollback: Revert only the successor candidate commit; do not restore autonomous remote I/O without a controlled-delivery migration ADR.
nodes.lesson: An immutable caller flag is not a grant, and a retired runtime must not retain a second remote authority path.

nodes.objective: Quarantine public raw GitHub write methods and move the production workspace push behind a grant-bound, effect-context-bound controlled-delivery contract without breaking receipt or recovery guarantees.
required_tests: PYTHONPATH=src python -m unittest tests.test_delivery_grants tests.test_hive_cortex_effects tests.test_hive_cortex_delivery tests.test_github_adapter -v
nodes.stopping_condition: Raw GitHub write methods deny before Git or HTTP; a workspace push requires a live grant-bound effect invocation and a grant-matching remote; independent Curator and Judge receipts verify migration and rollback.
nodes.rollback: Quarantine or revert the migration while retaining existing raw-surface evidence; never claim raw delivery is controlled before the contract proves it.
nodes.lesson: A safe caller does not make a public unsafe primitive safe; an adapter that delegates to raw delivery merely moves the bypass one layer down.

nodes.objective: Prepare a replaceable external-root verifier integration contract that records attestation, verification, expiry, revocation, and receipt bindings while refusing to call a local root external authority.
nodes.stopping_condition: A local root is refused as external; a verified attestation is exact-bound and live; missing, mismatched, expired, rejected, or revoked evidence fails closed; independent Curator and Judge receipts adopt only the local interface.
nodes.rollback: Revert the integration contract as one candidate; retain the external-root boundary and never replace it with a local key or HMAC workaround.
nodes.lesson: A verifier interface makes integration possible, but a fixture verifier is not an external operator.

nodes.objective: Provide an externally administered root verifier/signing authority with custody, identity, rotation, revocation, deployment, and rollback evidence.
required_tests: Owner-controlled verifier deployment and independently witnessed revocation/rotation probe
nodes.stopping_condition: An operator outside the agent process supplies and witnesses the verifier; no self-generated or in-process key qualifies.
nodes.rollback: Disable the deployment integration and retain the verifier evidence; never rewrite custody records.
nodes.lesson: Issuer strings and hashes establish integrity records, not external authority.

nodes.objective: Independently reproduce the local residual probes on the exact candidate, verify all changed paths and tests, and preserve dissent or open residuals.
nodes.stopping_condition: An independently identified Curator records an exact-candidate verdict, test result, dissent, and residual matrix without editing implementation paths.
nodes.rollback: No production state changes; preserve the audit as append-only evidence.
nodes.lesson: A Builder regression is evidence, not an independent disposition.

nodes.objective: Issue an independent disposition for the scoped local fail-closed candidate without promoting it to full authority.
required_tests: Review Curator receipt, exact-head CI receipt, rollback evidence, and all dissent
nodes.stopping_condition: A Judge distinct from Builder and Curator records adopt, adapt, defer, reject, or quarantine for this local candidate and explicitly excludes full-authority promotion.
nodes.rollback: Defer or reject local adoption while retaining all decisions, probes, and dissent.
nodes.lesson: A local adoption verdict is not an authority-promotion verdict.

nodes.objective: Independently reproduce RAW-GITHUB-2070's no-I/O denial, grant/remote binding, effect-context, host-allowlist, and controlled recovery assertions on the exact migration candidate.
required_tests: PYTHONPATH=src python -m unittest tests.test_delivery_grants tests.test_hive_cortex_effects tests.test_hive_cortex_delivery tests.test_github_adapter -v
nodes.stopping_condition: A Curator distinct from Builder records an exact-head disposition, commands/results, changed-path audit, dissent, and an explicit no-external-root finding without editing implementation paths.
nodes.rollback: No production state changes; preserve the independent review and defer adoption if any raw route remains reachable.
nodes.lesson: Testing the controlled adapter is insufficient when the old client used by its executor remained callable.

nodes.objective: Independently reproduce ROOT-INTERFACE-3010's local no-claim, attestation/verification binding, expiry, and revocation assertions while distinguishing protocol fixtures from external custody evidence.
nodes.stopping_condition: A Curator distinct from Builder records an exact-head verdict, negative tests, changed-path audit, dissent, and explicit statement that no external verifier/custody was observed.
nodes.rollback: No production state changes; preserve the review and leave ROOT-3000 blocked if evidence is incomplete.
nodes.lesson: A verifier protocol can be locally correct while no verifier exists outside the process.

nodes.objective: Issue a disposition for the raw-GitHub migration after independent reproduction, without converting local process guards into an external-authority claim.
required_tests: Review RAW-CURATOR-2970 receipt, exact-head CI receipt, ADR-064, rollback evidence, and preserved dissent
nodes.stopping_condition: A Judge distinct from Builder and Curator records adopt, adapt, defer, reject, or quarantine for RAW-GITHUB-2070 and explicitly leaves ROOT-3000/promotion outside the verdict.
nodes.rollback: Defer or reject raw-migration adoption while retaining all receipt and dissent evidence.
nodes.lesson: A local effect context can prevent a raw bypass; it cannot authenticate the party that granted authority.

nodes.objective: Issue a scoped disposition for the external-root integration contract without representing its fixture verifier as deployed custody or promoting ROOT-3000.
required_tests: Review ROOT-CURATOR-3020 receipt, exact-head CI receipt, ADR-065, external-root absence, rollback evidence, and dissent
nodes.stopping_condition: A Judge distinct from Builder and Curator records adopt, adapt, defer, reject, or quarantine for the local integration contract and expressly leaves ROOT-3000 blocked pending operator evidence.
nodes.rollback: Defer or reject integration-contract adoption while retaining all evidence and the external-root blocker.
nodes.lesson: Integration readiness is not root deployment, custody, or authority.

nodes.objective: Judge any full-authority or real-remote-delivery promotion only after an externally operated root is independently evidenced; the local raw-GitHub and root-interface successors are already independently adopted.
required_tests: Review both local Judge receipts, external-root witness, exact-head CI receipt, rollback evidence, and all dissent
nodes.stopping_condition: A Judge distinct from Builder, Curator, and root operator records a promotion disposition; no full-authority claim is issued without every dependency.
nodes.rollback: Defer or reject promotion while retaining all decisions, probes, and dissent.
nodes.lesson: Full authority requires both an authentic root and elimination of parallel raw delivery paths.
